items.title: 67256_Paul L. Howard oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] It could have been George, but George came here from Chicago.

ctx.x: He went to Long Beach and brought up a band. (See, Les Hite and Lionel, George Orendorff -- he's a trombone player (Inaudible) and Louis (inaudible)) on the circuit, and some woman, brought them out here. He was just a young boy,
see. And they were playing a date there in Long Beach. And Lionel got into a little trouble (inaudible).
